text:
devon: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off a shadowbench to compare Llama-70B, Mistral-7B-Instruct, and Qwen-7B across A100 and H100 in us-west1 and eu-west1. Scope: 4k vs 32k context, rope vs GQA kernel choices, int8 quant, and end-to-end p99 latency + steady-state throughput. Will post a short summary when runs finish. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sara: Do we have the GQA+ROPE kernel builds for H100 images? I remember only A100 had the patched libkernels last month.

miguel: We pushed patched kernels to the internal h100-images image-weekly-2026-03-05. Path: `/images/h100/libkernels/gqa-rope/v1.2/`. H100 build includes the new attention kernel but need user-space flags to enable (see below).

devon: Command I'm using for reproducibility:

```
./run_bench.sh \
  --model ${MODEL} \
  --gpu ${GPU} \
  --region ${REGION} \
  --context_lens 4096,32768 \
  --quant int8 \
  --kernels rope,gqa \
  --batch_sizes 1,4,8 \
  --tokens 1024 \
  --output json
```

benchbot: Running shadowbench job `sb-1772601122` on A100/us-west1 (dev pool). ETA ~18m. Logs: /internal/bench/sb-1772601122/logs

ci-bot: Noted. Comparing identical docker image sha `sha256:9a3f...c2b7`.

benchbot: Quick interim results (first 4k runs on A100/us-west1):
```
Llama-70B (int8, rope): p50=120ms p95=210ms p99=340ms  tokens/s=320
Mistral-7B (int8, rope): p50=45ms p95=80ms p99=150ms   tokens/s=740
Qwen-7B  (int8, gqa):  p50=60ms p95=110ms p99=200ms  tokens/s=680
```

anna: Interesting — Mistral looks very fast on rope int8 (A100). Did you run the same on H100? I want to see if H100 gives the same relative lift or if kernel selection flips preference.

devon: H100 runs completing now. H100/us-west1 interim:
```
Llama-70B (int8, rope): p99=280ms tokens/s=420
Mistral-7B (int8, rope): p99=120ms tokens/s=880
Qwen-7B (int8, gqa): p99=180ms tokens/s=720
```

miguel: That matches expectation: Mistral kernel benefits more from H100 tensor-core layout; the rope kernel's fused attention path hits better peak throughput. But note: GQA kernel on Qwen still needs small patch for large context on H100 (we see a 5% tail spike).

devon: Follow-up: ran 32k context on eu-west1 (H100) with kv-cache stress test. Observed p99 regression for Llama-70B when using rope kernel + int8: p99 jumped to ~1.1s and tokens/s dropped 60%. Log snippet: `OOM-like GC in kv-cache at step 28`.

anna: Could be kv-cache alignment issue with our slab allocator + GQA offset. Did you enable the new allocator flag? `--kv-slab=large-pages`?

devon: I did not. Re-running with `--kv-slab=large-pages --kv-page-size=2MB` now. Also will try quantization fallback: dynamic at certain layers.

benchbot: Full evals finishing in ~6m. I will run the automated quality eval suite (eval-prompts-v2) against the int8 outputs and report BLEU/ROUGE/Regressions.

benchbot: Quality eval summary (int8 default quant):
```
Llama-70B: quality delta vs fp16 = -3.2% (notable drop on long-coherent questions)
Mistral-7B: quality delta vs fp16 = -12.4% (regression on math/formatting prompts)
Qwen-7B: quality delta vs fp16 = -4.7% (small artifacts around code blocks)
```

sara: Mistral -12% is concerning. Was that with per-tensor int8 only? Try layerwise GPTQ fallback or 4-bit for first N layers. We should also check eval set distribution — maybe it's skewed towards code/math where Mistral quantization hurts.

devon: Agreed. Action plan I'm proposing:
- Re-run Mistral with per-layer GPTQ on top 6 layers and int8 elsewhere.
- Re-run 32k Llama with large-pages kv-slab and verify kv GC fix.
- Collect A100/H100 p99 and steady-state tokens/s and produce region comparative charts.
- Add a kernel compatibility matrix doc row for the observed GQA rope behavior on H100 (patch needed).

miguel: I'll prepare a minimal kernel patch for Qwen's GQA offset to avoid the 5% tail spike and push to `kernel-patches/gqa-h100-2026-03-18`. Can we run quick canary on a single H100 machine after that?

anna: I can own the quality eval reruns for Mistral (GPTQ config) and send a diff report.

devon: Thanks — planning to summarize into a short post in #eng-ml with charts and a table of recommended defaults by model+gpu+context (e.g., Mistral-H100: rope+int8 with GPTQ-top6; Llama-70B: fp16 for 32k context or int8+large-pages).

sara: Nice. Please include cost-per-token delta vs baseline fp16 in the table. That will help product decide rollout.

benchbot: Canary started for `kernel-patches/gqa-h100-2026-03-18` on one host in eu-west1. I will comment results in this thread. :mag_right:

devon: Great. If anyone finds additional regressions, drop short notes here. I'll post final summary with links to raw JSON outputs and chart svgs in ~2 hours.

miguel: tagging infra on-call @infra-oncall for potential need to reprovision H100 instances for the canary.

benchbot: Final note: raw bench artifacts saved to `/internal/bench/artifacts/sb-1772601122/` (json + perf histograms).
